referenceFunction.generalComment:
This dataset represents the supply of 1 kilowatt hour of electricity in a residence, by methanol conversion in a fuel cell, DMFC. The methanol is distributed by truck from regional storage. The methanol is produced from hydrogen supplied by Electrolysis, PEM, with electricity from Solar PV + Wind (MA) as feedstock. The carbon is sourced from DAC. Electricity conversion efficiency [% LHV input]: 30%. LHV [kWh/kg]: 5.56. Market price [Euro/MJ]: 0.03. Distribution loss [% output]: 0%. Storage loss [% output]: 0%. Synthesis efficiency [% LHV input]: 0%. Hydrogen production efficiency [% LHV input]: 0. Total cap. Input-related [kW]: 3.33. CO2 biogenic share [%]: 100%. Power [kW]: 1.67. Lifetime [years]: 2.93. Annual operation [hours]: 4100. : . For more information, refer to: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023. Source: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023.
